integration_issues.issue: On web preview, when /api/billing/checkout returns 500 (placeholder Stripe key), no visible Alert dialog appears to the user — Alert.alert on React Native Web is a known no-op / non-modal fallback. No crash and user stays on upgrade-screen, but users get no explicit feedback. Consider swapping Alert.alert for an in-screen error banner or a custom Modal so the same UX works on both native and web. Reference: /app/frontend/app/upgrade.tsx (upgrade-cta-button handler).

action_items: OPTIONAL (polish): Replace Alert.alert with an inline error banner or custom Modal on the /upgrade screen so users on web preview also see the Stripe checkout failure message. On native this is fine; on web the alert is silently swallowed.

OPTIONAL (from prior review, still valid): Mirror the 'STRIPE_API_KEY not configured' guard from /api/billing/checkout onto /api/billing/verify to avoid a raw 500 if the key becomes empty at verify time.
